title: local-env source manifest
description: local-env.yml at the root of a source repo: its name, its label and the accounts it needs (https://cgaube.github.io/local-env/write-a-source/source-repo).

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. local-env ignores it.

name.description: The name of the source on every Mac: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Unique: local-env skips a repo whose name is already added. Other sources name yours by it (acme-platform/postgres).

label.description: What the dashboard and the CLI show for the source, in place of its name. Free text.

logins.description: The accounts that the templates and the tools of the source need, by login name.

type.description: registry: a registry of private images, for the templates.

registry.description: A registry of private images. local-env asks the user for a username and a token, which Dockhand keeps.

host.description: The registry host: ghcr.io. A path (ghcr.io/team) is the same login: Docker keeps one login for each host.

usernameHelp.description: Shown when local-env asks for the username: what to give.

tokenHelp.description: Shown when local-env asks for the token: what to give, and where to get it.
